title: Maximum Total Subarray Value II
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, select exactly k distinct subarrays such that the total value, defined as the sum of the differences between the maximum and minimum values in each subarray, is maximized.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, select exactly k distinct subarrays such that the total value, defined as the sum of the differences between the maximum and minimum values in each subarray, is maximized.
constraints: One to 50,000 nonnegative integers, each at most one billion.
Choose exactly k distinct nonempty subarrays; overlapping is allowed.
k is at most 100,000 and at most n(n+1)/2.
target_time_complexity: O(n log n + k log n)
hints: For a fixed left endpoint, extending the right endpoint never decreases max minus min.
Each left endpoint forms a sorted stream of values; merge the n streams with a max heap.
Use static range minimum/maximum queries, seed each stream at right=n-1, and push its preceding right endpoint after every pop.
The heap always exposes the largest unchosen head, so k pops are exactly the globally largest k distinct subarray values.
editorial: The heap always exposes the largest unchosen head, so k pops are exactly the globally largest k distinct subarray values.

tests.explanation: The ranges [1,3] and [1,3,2] each contribute two, totaling four.
